Kenya AI Compute solves this by strategically locating 1MW of IT load directly at the source of power generation in Kenya. Our project is not just a data center; it is a sophisticated energy arbitrage engine. We take electricity at $0.04/kWh and convert it into high-value digital exports—computational power for LLM training, real-time inference, and decentralized AI networks. By eliminating grid fees and middleman markups, we offer a sustainable, high-margin alternative to the overcrowded data centers of Europe and the US. Our hybrid architecture, optimized for 30% GPU and 50% CPU workloads, ensures maximum utilization and consistent dollar-denominated revenue for our investors.

hero.headline: The Power Behind the Intelligence

sections.title: Vertically Integrated Power Strategy
sections.body: Energy is the single largest operational cost for any data center, accounting for up to 70% of OPEX. Kenya AI Compute circumvents high public utility rates through a captive generation model. By integrating our modular data center with a dedicated power plant, we capture the 'energy arbitrage' opportunity. We generate electricity at an industrial cost of $0.04-$0.06/kWh, whereas the standard grid rates for data centers in most countries range from $0.15 to $0.25/kWh. Our hybrid generation mix primarily uses natural gas and solar, with diesel generators providing N+1 redundancy. This ensures that even in the unlikely event of a primary generation failure, our AI workloads continue to run without interruption. This strategy not only protects our margins but also offers our clients long-term price stability that is impossible to find in traditional cloud markets.

meta.title: Energy Efficiency and PUE | Kenya AI Compute
meta.description: Our engineering approach to PUE. Smart cooling, load balancing, and how we achieve 1.3-1.5 efficiency.

hero.headline: Efficiency in Every Watt
hero.subheadline: We don't just use cheap power; we use it wisely. Our target PUE of 1.3-1.5 sets the standard for data centers in Africa.

sections.title: Maximizing Yield Through Smart Engineering
sections.body: Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) is the gold standard for measuring data center efficiency. While many African data centers struggle with PUEs above 2.0 due to high ambient temperatures and outdated cooling tech, Kenya AI Compute targets a hyper-efficient range of 1.3 to 1.5. We achieve this through a combination of outside air economizers, evaporative cooling, and a strict hot/cold aisle containment strategy. By leveraging Kenya's specific climate, which features moderate temperatures and low humidity in our site location, we can utilize 'free cooling' for a significant portion of the year. Every rack is equipped with intelligent PDU units that monitor consumption down to the individual server, allowing our AI-driven BMS to dynamically adjust cooling and power distribution for maximum performance and minimum waste.

sections.title: Efficiency Drivers
items: Hot/Cold Aisle Containment: Eliminates air mixing and reduces cooling load.
Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs): Automatically adjust fan speeds based on real-time heat load.
LED Smart Lighting: Zero-waste auxiliary power consumption.
AI-BMS: Predictive load balancing to prevent thermal hotspots.
Modular Expansion: Only cooling the active load, avoiding the 'empty hall' cooling waste.

meta.title: Tier II/III Standards and Uptime | Kenya AI Compute
meta.description: Understanding our reliability standards. Why Tier II+ is the optimal choice for AI and DePIN workloads.

hero.headline: Reliability at Scale
hero.subheadline: We deliver 99.9%+ uptime by combining Tier II baseline infrastructure with simplified Tier III redundancies for critical power and cooling.

sections.title: Engineered for AI Continuity
sections.body: Traditional Tier IV data centers are often over-engineered for AI workloads, leading to unnecessarily high CAPEX and rental rates. Kenya AI Compute utilizes an optimized 'Tier II+' design. This means we maintain N+1 redundancy on all critical systems (UPS, cooling, power generation) while avoiding the excessive costs of full concurrent maintainability where it isn't required for machine learning tasks. Since AI training and rendering tasks are naturally fault-tolerant at the software level, our design provides the perfect balance of 99.9% uptime and low cost-per-watt. For clients requiring higher levels of security, we offer specialized racks that meet full Tier III elements, ensuring that mission-critical inference APIs remain online even during maintenance windows.

sections.title: Standard of Quality
items: Uptime Target: 99.9%+ annual availability guaranteed.
Power Path: Dual-path power distribution to every rack.
Cooling: N+1 redundant precision air conditioning units.
Maintenance: Scheduled windows with zero impact on DePIN earnings.
Compliance: Designed with future ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certification in mind.

hero.headline: A Pro-Investment Regulatory Environment
hero.subheadline: Kenya offers world-class incentives for high-tech infrastructure through Special Economic Zones and robust legal protections.

sections.title: Protecting Global Capital
sections.body: Kenya is widely recognized as one of the most investor-friendly nations in Africa. Our project is structured to take full advantage of the Special Economic Zones (SEZ) Act, which provides a comprehensive package of fiscal and non-fiscal incentives. For investors, this means a drastically reduced corporate tax rate of 10% for the first 10 years, exemption from VAT on all project-related expenditures, and zero customs duties on imported high-tech equipment. Furthermore, Kenya has a fully liberalized capital account, meaning there are no restrictions on the repatriation of profits, dividends, or capital in USD. Our legal structure is designed to be familiar to international funds, utilizing standard Joint Venture agreements and arbitration clauses to ensure maximum transparency and security for all stakeholders.

sections.title: Incentive Framework
items: Corporate Tax: 10% for the first decade of operation within SEZ.
Import Duties: 0% on servers, UPS systems, and specialized cooling equipment.
Profit Repatriation: 100% freedom to remit earnings globally in USD.
Investment Protection: Guaranteed against expropriation via the Foreign Investment Protection Act.
Work Permits: Facilitated entry for key technical and management personnel.
